name: Monkey Jumpers V2
summary:
Monkey Jumpers V2 is an immersive multiplayer VR experience that redefines social and competitive gaming. Moving beyond its predecessor's horror theme, V2 introduces a vibrant world with diverse gameplay features, including parkour, zero-gravity, and intricate modes designed for up to 10 players.
